Two synthetic holders preserve the surviving contribution
Registered fixture physical source survives synthetic retirement (headless model)

Revocation before final guard discards pending work without effects
Revocation after authority application preserves debt before writer completion
Publication transition refuses old focus/seat snapshot during the gap
Thawed work revalidates generation, epoch and publication
New connection or grant generation inherits no queued work or holds
Retirement and tombstones persist until native and recipient obligations settle
Delayed old writer release cannot clear a newer recipient hold
Route removal while recipient lives retains targeted debt
More than64 simultaneous debts remain represented without retirement allocation
Reserved completion survives wake coalescing and grant-slot retirement
Seventeenth grant and full domain refuse before any side effect
Synthetic cannot supply protected chord and cannot taint sufficient fixture physical chord
Key, pointer, repeat and cleanup share instance execution order

Real private stalled socket reader is contained while healthy peer continues
Guarded APIs and contending writers preserve selected lock order
Unavailable or revoked instance authority refuses without ambient backend acquisition
